materials:
Ingredients
• Spelt flour — 300 g (white or whole wheat)
• Warm water — 150 ml
• Plain Greek yogurt — 100 g (thick, unsweetened)
• Dry yeast — 1 tsp
• Sugar — 1 tsp
• Salt — 1 tsp
• Olive oil — 1 tbsp
steps:
Method
1. In a large bowl, mix the flour, dry yeast, sugar, and salt.
2. Add the warm water, yogurt, and olive oil.
3. Knead into a soft, slightly sticky dough.
4. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1–1½ hours, until doubled in size.
5. Divide the dough into 6–8 pieces and roll each into a circle about 5 mm thick.
6. Preheat the oven to 240–250°C (465–480°F) with a baking tray or pizza stone inside.
7. Bake for 3–5 minutes, until the pitas puff up and lightly brown.
8. Transfer immediately into a clean kitchen towel to keep them
